maintenance_led.reason: Sells frac sand consumed in oil and gas well completions, plus industrial sand; consumable product, not repair or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private oil and gas exploration and production companies and industrial buyers, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling sand from its own mines; acquisitions are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Frac sand is a largely commodity product bought on price and logistics; customers can switch suppliers fairly easily.
